coverage.assessment: The actual inclusion is analytic. The manifold chain rule and tangent-to-vector map give the ambient derivative; lower-bound lines 286-293 supply the interior derivWithin/deriv comparison.
Differentiating the unit constraint gives orthogonality. The x-cf norm identity and Cauchy-Schwarz yield the required bound without assuming unit speed.

0<a<1 makes the square-root denominator positive. The signed derivative is bounded by speed, both functions are integrable, and FTC/monotonicity apply. Closure of {a:F(a)<=L} handles a=1 without differentiating arccos at its singular endpoints.

The residual is orthogonal to x and has norm sin(theta). Normalize when nonzero; otherwise choose an element of the n-dimensional orthogonal-complement basis using hn. Coincident and antipodal pairs are covered.

The orthonormal frame supplies a smooth sphere lift with unit speed in angle time. The cited interval comparison accepts a<=b and uses an affine reparametrization valid for theta=0. Unit-interval speed one is not claimed.

A hypothetically shorter path is extracted from the infimum. Continuous ambient within speed is integrable; Ioo/Ioc measure equality, ofReal-integral equality and the inclusion derivative identify its formal length. The universal angle lower bound contradicts shortness.
